Experience in Outpatient Psychiatry or Behavioral Health Clinic
Experience administering Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS)
Experience in data collection, organization, and reporting
Experience with coordinating referrals, authorizations, and scheduling patients
Experience in coordination of benefits and authorizations

The ECT Coordinator/TMS Technician (Hospital Assistant II) supports the delivery of specialized psychiatric treatment services through the Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT) and Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) programs at UC Davis Health. This position coordinates the administrative and operational activities of the ECT program while providing hands-on TMS treatment services in accordance with established clinical protocols and required training.
50% - Patient Care Duties

Working collaboratively with physicians, nursing staff, and other healthcare professionals, the ECT Coordinator/TMS Technician supports patient referrals, appointment scheduling, insurance authorizations, Epic work queues, and communication throughout the treatment process. The position applies prior TMS administration experience while completing required equipment-specific training and maintaining established patient safety and treatment standards.
50% - Administrative Duties

As an important member of the psychiatric care team, the ECT Coordinator/TMS Technician helps patients navigate their treatment experience, maintains accurate documentation, and supports continuity of care. The role requires strong technical, organizational, communication skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to compassionate, patient-centered care.
Must perform all responsibilities as required and assigned by department leadership
Must see well enough to observe patient reactions and read relevant monitors, relevant device settings, and relevant written information such as the patient's medical record
Must be detail-oriented, able to prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines
Demonstrated basic computer skills and the ability/willingness to learn additional computer programs and systems (i.e., email, Excel, Word, MS. Office, etc.)
Verbal and written communication skills to effectively communicate with hospital staff in a clear, concise, professional manner
Skill in organizing written material
Knowledge of appropriate information required for patient and supply record-keeping
Skills and ability to work in stressful situations
Tact and diplomacy skills
Ability to provide and accept guidance and criticism
Knowledge and skill in the use of email, Excel, Word, and ability/ willingness to learn additional computer programs and systems
Ability to work well in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary healthcare environment
Excellent organizational and time-management skills
Ability to handle confidential information with integrity and adhere to HIPAA guidelines
Ability to work under pressure, maintain professionalism, and handle difficult or stressful situations
Knowledge of authorizations and referral process
